author: Anitha Swaminathan
text: The buttercup daisy dress is super cute and feather light. It survived 10 washes with zero fading!

author: Sneha M.
text: The Sage Linen Ruffle Frock is unimaginably soft! Most baby party dresses have rough tulle, but this one is pure organic muslin on the inside. My 8-month daughter looked adorable on her naming ceremony. No skin rashes or redness whatsoever!

author: Rohan & Deepa
text: Ordered the Lilac Fairy Tulle Ballerina for my niece's 1st birthday. Arrived in 2 days with safe packaging. The snap buttons make diaper changes super easy without taking off the whole dress! The lavender shade is so elegant in photos.

author: Kavita Rajan
text: We have 4 frocks from LittleBloom now. After 15 machine washes, the colors haven't faded at all. The 3D view on this website showed the exact flare before buying. Highly recommended for hot South Indian summers.

author: Ananya Sharma
text: Bought the Little Lion costume for baby milestone photoshoot. The inner fleece is ultra breathable and zero itching! The hood ears stand up gently without hurting baby's soft head. Everyone at the party went gaga over it!

author: Dr. Meera Nambiar
text: As a pediatrician, I am extremely particular about baby fabrics. LittleBloom’s 100% GOTS organic cotton and tagless neckline prevent friction dermatitis. The coconut buttons are sewn with infant-safe double lock stitch.

author: Vikram & Pooja
text: The matching baby headband included with the blush frock is so gentle and doesn't leave marks on her forehead. The muslin layers are light as air. Express delivery reached us in Pune within 36 hours!

author: Nandhini Sundaram
dress: Little Krishna Festive Silk-Cotton Kurta Set
text: Traditional festive wear for babies is usually stiff and scratchy, but LittleBloom’s Krishna costume has pure mulmul lining inside. My grandson wore it happily throughout the pooja without crying!

author: Tanvi Kapoor
text: Gorgeous earthy terracotta shade! Perfect for festive evening outings. Sizing was slightly roomy for 12-18M, which turned out great because she can wear it for another 4 months easily.
